payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iteratively maintains list of all possible cumulative angles modulo 360 by adding/subtracting each rotation, checking if any results in 0.
payload.rationale: The solution effectively computes all reachable sums after each rotation, which is a DP over the sum dimension (1D state). No explicit indexing of rotation count in state, but iterates over items and expands set of possible sums. Matches dp_1d_state.
